title: 亨利·卡文迪许发现氢气

summary.text: 1766年，极度害羞的英国科学家亨利·卡文迪许（Henry Cavendish）发表了著名的论文《人造空气》（On Factitious Airs）。他通过将金属（如锌、铁）溶解在酸中，分离出一种极其轻盈的气体，他称之为“易燃空气”（Inflammable Air）。虽然之前也有人制备过这种气体，但卡文迪许是第一个将其视为一种独立物质并精确测量其性质的人。他发现这种气体的密度只有空气的1/11，而且最关键的是，这种气体燃烧后会生成水（这彻底推翻了水是元素的古老观念）。后来，拉瓦锡根据这一特性将其命名为“氢”（Hydrogen），意为“水的生成者”。
summary.text_en: In 1766, the intensely shy British scientist Henry Cavendish published his famous paper 'On Factitious Airs'. By dissolving metals (like zinc and iron) in acid, he isolated an extremely light gas which he called 'Inflammable Air'. Although others had produced it before, Cavendish was the first to recognize it as a distinct substance and precisely measure its properties. He found its density to be only 1/11th that of air, and most critically, that it produced water when burned (which completely overturned the ancient idea that water is an element). Lavoisier later named it 'Hydrogen' (Water-Former) based on this property.
key_points: 首次鉴别并分离出“氢气”作为独立物质
发现氢气燃烧生成水（证明水不是元素）
精确测量了氢气的密度（非常轻）
通过置换反应（金属+酸）制备气体
为拉瓦锡的燃烧理论奠定基础
key_points_en: First to identify and isolate 'Hydrogen' as a distinct substance
Discovered that burning hydrogen produces water (proving water is not an element)
Prepared gas via displacement reaction (metal + acid)
Laid the foundation for Lavoisier's combustion theory

story.text: 卡文迪许是当时英国最富有的人之一，但他生活简朴，唯一的奢侈品就是科学仪器。他把他在伦敦的豪宅改造成了一个巨大的实验室，甚至把床挤到了角落里。在进行氢气实验时，他不仅测量了重量，还勇敢（或者说鲁莽）地去点燃它。当他看到这种气体在爆炸后，干燥的玻璃容器壁上出现了晶莹的露珠时，他不仅发现了一种新元素，还无意中解开了困扰人类数千年的“水之谜”——水不再是构成世界的基本元素，而是这种“易燃空气”的氧化产物。
story.text_en: Cavendish was one of the wealthiest men in England, but lived simply, his only luxury being scientific instruments. He turned his London mansion into a giant laboratory, even pushing his bed into a corner. When experimenting with hydrogen, he didn't just weigh it; he bravely (or recklessly) ignited it. When he saw that after the explosion, crystal-clear dew appeared on the walls of the dry glass container, he had not only discovered a new element but also unwittingly solved the 'Mystery of Water' that had puzzled humanity for millennia—water was no longer a basic element of the world, but the oxidation product of this 'Inflammable Air'.

fun_facts.text: 卡文迪许社恐到了极点。他不仅不和女仆说话（通过便条交流），甚至在皇家学会开会时，如果有人盯着他看，他会发出一声尖叫然后逃跑。
fun_facts.text_en: Cavendish was socially anxious to the extreme. Not only did he not speak to his maids (communicating via notes), but even at Royal Society meetings, if someone stared at him, he would let out a squeak and run away.

fun_facts.text: 他在1783年利用氢气的超轻特性，制造并释放了一个氢气球，这比法国的孟格菲兄弟的热气球还要早几个月（虽然只是无人实验）。
fun_facts.text_en: In 1783, utilizing hydrogen's ultra-light property, he built and launched a hydrogen balloon, months before the Montgolfier brothers' hot air balloon in France (though his was unmanned).

fun_facts.text: 虽然发现了氢，但他最著名的实验其实是“称量地球”（Cavendish experiment），他用极其精密的扭秤测量出了地球的密度。
fun_facts.text_en: Although he discovered hydrogen, his most famous experiment was actually 'Weighing the Earth' (Cavendish experiment), where he used an incredibly precise torsion balance to measure the Earth's density.

simple_explanation.text:
卡文迪许就像一个拥有精密天平的魔术师。他把金属扔进酸里，抓住了冒出来的“气泡”。
1. 他称了称这些气泡，发现它们轻得不可思议（大约比空气轻11倍，如果你松手，它们会飞向太空）。
2. 他点燃了这些气泡，发现它们会爆炸。
3. 最神奇的是，爆炸后留下的不是灰烬，而是“水”。
他发现了宇宙中最基本、最轻的元素——氢，并证明了水不是一种元素，而是这种气体燃烧后的“灰烬”。
simple_explanation.text_en:
Cavendish was like a magician with a precision scale. He threw metal into acid and caught the 'bubbles'.
1. He weighed the bubbles and found them incredibly light (about 11 times lighter than air; if let go, they float to space).
2. He lit them on fire, and they exploded.
3. The magic trick: after the explosion, all that was left was 'water'.
He discovered the universe's most basic, lightest element—Hydrogen—and proved that water is not an element, but the 'ash' of burning this gas.

applications.title: 火箭燃料
applications.text: 液氢是能量密度极高的燃料，它是把人类送上月球（土星五号）和送入轨道（航天飞机）的主要推力来源。
applications.text_en: Liquid hydrogen is an incredibly high-energy fuel; it was the main source of thrust that sent humans to the moon (Saturn V) and into orbit (Space Shuttle).

applications.title: 飞艇与气球
applications.text: 因为氢气是宇宙中最轻的气体，它曾是齐柏林飞艇和气象气球的主要升力来源（尽管因易燃而具有危险性）。
applications.text_en: Because hydrogen is the lightest gas in the universe, it was the primary lifting gas for Zeppelins and weather balloons (despite the danger of flammability).

applications.title: 清洁能源
applications.text: 氢燃料电池通过氢和氧的化学反应产生电能，排放物只有纯净的水，是未来的终极清洁能源。
applications.text_en: Hydrogen fuel cells generate electricity through the chemical reaction of hydrogen and oxygen, emitting only pure water, making it the ultimate clean energy of the future.

impact.text: 卡文迪许的发现是化学革命的关键转折点。首先，他发现了一种全新的、独特的物质（氢气）。其次，他证明了水（被视为四大元素之一）实际上是一种化合物。这一发现直接启发了拉瓦锡推翻燃素说，建立了现代燃烧理论。此外，他对气体密度的精确测量技术，也为后来的气球飞行和气体物理学奠定了基础。
impact.text_en: Cavendish's discovery was a pivotal turning point in the chemical revolution. First, he found a completely new, distinct substance (hydrogen). Second, he proved that water (considered one of the four elements) was actually a compound. This discovery directly inspired Lavoisier to overthrow the phlogiston theory and establish the modern theory of combustion. Furthermore, his precise techniques for measuring gas density laid the foundation for later balloon flight and gas physics.

influenced_by.contribution: 波义耳（曾观察到铁与酸反应产生气体，但未做定性研究；卡文迪许继承了其定量实验精神）
influenced_by.contribution_en: Robert Boyle (Observed gas production from iron and acid but didn't characterize it; Cavendish inherited his spirit of quantitative experimentation)

influenced.contribution: 拉瓦锡（利用卡文迪许“水是化合物”的发现，彻底击败了燃素说，并命名了氢气）
influenced.contribution_en: Lavoisier (Used Cavendish's discovery that 'water is a compound' to defeat the phlogiston theory and named Hydrogen)

influenced.contribution: 亨利·卡文迪许（他自己后来的实验，利用同样的精密测量精神，测出了地球的重量）
influenced.contribution_en: Henry Cavendish (His own later experiment, using the same spirit of precision measurement, to weigh the Earth)

influence_chain.legacy_text: 这位沉默寡言的天才，不仅送给了我们宇宙中最基本的元素，还顺便打破了关于水的千年神话。
influence_chain.legacy_text_en: This silent genius not only gave us the most basic element in the universe but also casually shattered the millennial myth about water.

quiz.question: 卡文迪许发现“易燃空气”（氢气）燃烧后会生成什么，从而证明了水不是元素？
quiz.question_en: What did Cavendish find was produced when 'Inflammable Air' (Hydrogen) burned, proving water is not an element?
quiz.explanation: 卡文迪许观察到这种气体燃烧后在容器壁上留下了露珠（水），这证明了水是由氢和氧组成的化合物，而非单一元素。
quiz.explanation_en: Cavendish observed that burning the gas left dew (water) on the container walls, proving that water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen, not a single element.
